title: IV fluid tonicity

findings.where: Images 1, 5, 6, 8, 12, 13; steps "bags" and "dextrose"; "Bags, as labeled" heading
findings.title: The bag list silently switches from tonicity to osmolarity
findings.problem: The facts explicitly distinguish osmolarity from effective tonicity, but the diagram, captions and narration never name osmolarity. They introduce tonicity using effective solutes, then group bags using all dissolved particles under the same isotonic/hypertonic labels. "As labeled" does not explain that change in criterion. The dextrose caveat gives the eventual effects but leaves the underlying distinction implicit.
findings.fix: Label the list "In-bag osmolarity: usual exam groupings" and add to the bags caption and narration: "Osmolarity counts all dissolved particles; tonicity describes their effective influence on cell volume." Retain the dextrose explanation.

assessment: No blocker found in the tonicity content or arrow directions. One student-facing terminology gap remains.
